# Pink Sky Beauty & Wellness

Beauty and wellness business serving Warri and Effurun, Delta State, Nigeria.

Core services:
Teeth Whitening, Facials & Skincare, Hair & Wig Studio, Nails, Spa & Massage,
Barbing & Grooming, Makeup & Brows, Microblading & Brows, Waxing, Beauty Products.

Locations:
- Shop 20/23, Delta Mall, Effurun, Delta State
